attributes.board_name: State of Ohio Board of Pharmacy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing pharmacy education in pharmacy technician-specific subject matter; up to one-third may be earned by volunteer health care services (R.C. 4745.04) at an approved in-state provider
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required if the initial registration was obtained within six months of the registration's expiration date.
rules.audit_note: CE units are reported to a national and/or state register (e.g. CPE Monitor); keep certificates from non-ACPE providers one year after the year they were required; Board audits registrants.
rules.notes: 10 contact hours in the 24 months before the registration expires, including 2 hours law and 2 hours patient or medication safety.
rules.rule_quote: (A) As a condition for the renewal of a registration as a registered pharmacy technician, the registrant shall complete a total of ten contact hours (1.0 C.E.Us) of continuing pharmacy education during the twenty-four months preceding the expiration date of the technician's registration.

rules.alternatives: No state-set hours: the technician must complete all CE needed to keep the pharmacy technician certification from a Board-recognized organization (e.g. PTCB, ExCPT); no CE is reported directly to the Board.
rules.notes: Certified technicians follow their national certifier's recertification CE (OAC 4729:3-5-02(E)).
rules.rule_quote: (E) As a condition for the renewal of a registration as a certified pharmacy technician, the registrant shall complete all continuing education requirements necessary to maintain the registrant's pharmacy technician certification from an organization that has been recognized by the board.
